scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm --filter chatto-desktop build
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend build
scripts.check:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend check
scripts.check:desktop: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend check && pnpm --filter chatto-desktop check
scripts.dev:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend dev
scripts.knip:prepare: pnpm --dir apps/frontend run paraglide && pnpm --dir apps/frontend run prepare
scripts.lint:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend lint
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm run build:api-types && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend exec vitest --run
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm --filter chatto-frontend exec node --test scripts/run-desktop.test.mjs scripts/i18n-facade-sources.test.mjs && pnpm --filter chatto-frontend exec vitest --run src/lib/native src/lib/api-client/connect.spec.ts src/lib/state/server/eventBus.svelte.spec.ts src/lib/state/server/voiceCall.svelte.spec.ts src/lib/voice/webrtcDiagnostics.spec.ts && pnpm --filter chatto-desktop test
